setup: Sit or stand tall with an upright spine and relaxed shoulders.
Gently tilt your right ear toward your right shoulder without elevating the shoulder.
steps: Slowly roll your chin downward toward the center of your chest in a smooth arc.
Continue the sweeping motion upward until your left ear nears your left shoulder.
Pause briefly, then reverse the trajectory, rolling your chin smoothly back down across your chest to the starting side.
instructions.breathing: Breathe continuously and evenly throughout the movement, never holding your breath.
cues: Draw a smooth arc with your chin
Move slowly without forcing the range

common_faults.fault: Rolling the head backward into hyperextension
common_faults.correction: Restrict the movement to the front hemisphere only, passing through chest flexion rather than rolling backwards.

common_faults.fault: Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears
common_faults.correction: Actively depress and relax the shoulders so neck mobility is isolated.

common_faults.fault: Moving rapidly or bouncing at the end range
common_faults.correction: Perform the movement at a slow, deliberate pace under full muscular control.

precautions: Stop immediately if you experience dizziness, numbness, tingling, or sharp pain.

name: Neck Half Circle
summary: A gentle cervical mobility exercise that rolls the head in a smooth semicircle from shoulder to shoulder across the chest.
